comment: Press Pull continued Straight or Along the walls (mitcad#1850), tools/ui-press-pull-continued-test.sh: Revolve1 (F2) turns the circle c2 of radius 10 at (30, 0) of Sketch1 (F1) a quarter about the Y axis, a bent tube (Body1, F2.b0) from the XY plane round to its end F2:end(r{c2}) in the plane x = 0, facing -x. A 20 x 20 bar 40 long (Box F3, Body2, F3.b0) at x -120 to -100 with a T-slot in its +y side (a 6 wide opening 2 deep over a 12 wide undercut 4 high, F4 and F5) and a bore of diameter 5 below it (F6); its end F3:top at z = 40. All geometry is synthetic.
